_comment: The embedder registry: everything that varies from one embedder to the next, in
one place, keyed by model identity.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. These facts used to be scattered across three files —
coordinates in aimee-llm-supervisor.sh's embed_coords(), pooling ~110 lines away in
the same script, prefixes in aimee_llm_gateway.py, the width in src/headers/aimee.h.
Two of them fail SILENTLY when wrong, and both have already gone wrong:
- pooling defaulted to `last`, correct for Qwen3 and wrong for nomic. Wrong
pooling yields vectors that are correctly shaped, correctly normalised and
simply wrong. Nothing errors; recall collapses.
- prefixes were absent entirely, so nomic served at 0.5823 NDCG@10 instead of
the 0.6075 it was selected on — below the runner-up it was chosen over.
Switching embedders should be adding one entry here, not a scavenger hunt across
three languages. Anything that is per-model belongs in this file; anything derived
at runtime (the deployed dimension: pinned > recorded > probed) does not.
EVERY FIELD IS REQUIRED, including empty prefixes. A model whose card defines no
prefixes declares that with empty strings — readers distinguish 'declared none'
from 'not registered', and refuse to serve the latter rather than guess.
Derive these from the model card, never by copying the previous entry. `prefixes`
comes from the card's usage section, `pooling` from its 1_Pooling/config.json, and
`context` from max_trained_positions (NOT the tokenizer's model_max_length, which
is often a smaller artifact).

notes: Selected on frozen-ab-v1 (10,000 cases / 26,473 documents) at 0.6075 NDCG@10
WITH these prefixes. Serving it without them measures 0.5823.
arch nomic-bert-moe is registered by the pinned llama.cpp LLAMA_TAG=b9775, so
serving it needs no runtime bump.
context 2048 is max_trained_positions; the tokenizer's model_max_length of 512
is an artifact, not a limit.
Q8_0 costs -0.0037 NDCG@10 against bf16, and ~3.6x a25m's CPU throughput
Not deployed — the measured runner-up (0.5909 NDCG@10), kept because it is the
worked example of a model whose card defines NO prefixes: the empty pair above
is a declaration, not a gap. Needing no prefixes means its benchmark score
carries into production unchanged, which is a real if unglamorous advantage.
Provisioning coordinates are blank because nothing fetches it; fill them in
